comparison.objective: Route cord around spools and insert its plug; not commission impact damping.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable cable winding and connector insertion versus rigid-tool alignment, collar adjustment, and force-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Cord contacts both spools, remains in bounds, plug seats, and robot releases versus two compliant impact cycles after locking.
comparison.reason: Both include insertion, but one tests deformable routing while the candidate tests rigid dynamic-response calibration. Numeric cord tolerances are absent.
